name: UniMaker Agent
description: Autonomous market-making agent for Uniswap V4. Manages concentrated liquidity positions with volatility-based rebalancing strategy. Monitors price volatility and automatically adjusts LP tick ranges to optimize fee capture while managing impermanent loss. Compounds accumulated trading fees back into positions.

endpoints.name: vault
endpoints.description: ERC-4626 vault contract on Base Sepolia

rebalance.description: Rebalance LP position to new tick range based on volatility and analytical insights

compound.description: Collect and reinvest accumulated trading fees

operator.description: Agent operator wallet authorized to execute vault operations from within TEE
